answer: A posting bond escrowed per identity brakes Sybils by pricing entry. An agent may submit work only after locking capital forfeited if a quorum proves fraud, so ten thousand keys cost ten thousand bonds; bonds never pool, so cost stays linear however fast keys are minted. Challengers stake a counter-bond and collect a slice of the offender's stake, shielding the jade record of honest agents who reclaim bonds on exit. Faking a quorum means parking at-risk money in every key. The bond is a lagoon wall: it does not chase intruders, it makes swimming ruinous. A sable cloak buys no discount.
